title: Empire of the Sun · Walking on a Dream (live)
description: The televised live performance unfolds above a misty river, with bronze bells, lacquered pavilions and a coral ribbon.

performance.lyrics: Six years ago, our next guest had a huge hit song. And now thanks to a few television commercials, that song is back on top of the charts. Here to perform Walking On A Dream, please welcome Empire Of The Sun. Thank you so much for watching. Ah Ah Ah Ah We are always running for the thrill of it, thrill of it Always pushing up the heels, searching for the thrill of it All I know, all know we are calling out and out again Never looking down just to know what's in front of me It's the freedom, do people I can feel love, you people become one. I'll never see love you found in me now it's changing all the time living in a rhythm weather minutes working over time we are always running for the thrill of it three loopy always pushing up the hill searching for the three of it all we are calling out now to get Never looking down. I'm just an oral what's in front of me Ah Ah Ah Ah can people become one He's a real one, and two people become one I can feel it, two People become one Catch me, I'm falling love I'm fully in love Don't stop, just keep going on I am your shoulder lean upon So come on, deliver from inside All we got is tonight That it's right for first life Is it real or not? When two people become one I can feel it all two people become one Is it real Ah but you'll be able to become one I can feel it all, you'll be able to come one Okay, good. like to know. The name of the CD is Walking on the Green! Everywhere audience will get a copy! We'll be back! Let's go!
